aboutH2: Personalized Addiction Treatment in the Mountains of British Columbia
intro: Foothills Centre for Change offers a personalized approach to addiction treatment in the serene mountains of British Columbia. The facility offers 30, 60, or 90 day programs with evidence-based therapies and holistic services. For those who cannot commit to the typical 30 day program, Foothills Centre also offers a 14-day intensive residential package. The treatment experience at Foothills Centre is well-rounded, including individual and group therapy sessions, 12-Step facilitation, social activities, exercise, healthy meals, and time for relaxation and reflection.

pillars.title: Comprehensive and Personalized Treatment
pillars.body: At Foothills Centre for Change, the focus is on treating the whole person, addressing the physical, mental, emotional, and spiritual aspects of addiction. Through therapeutic and educational groups, clients learn how to communicate honestly with themselves and others. Cognitive behavioral therapy (CBT) addresses negative thoughts and actions related to addiction. Further, Foothills Centre treats the root of addiction by addressing co-occurring disorders such as personality disorders, grief, trauma, and anxiety. Foothills Centre also offers a wellness program, which includes yoga, meditation, amino acid therapy, and social connection.

pillars.title: Recover in a Serene Location
pillars.body: Surrounded by the serene mountains of British Columbia, Foothills Centre for Change provides a peaceful setting for clients to recover. Private accommodations, weekly massages, and infra-red saunas are just a few of the amenities clients can enjoy during their stay. Family therapy sessions help reconnect clients with their support systems, and private aftercare sessions are included in all treatment packages.

pillars.title: Cost and Insurance Coverage
pillars.body: Foothills Centre for Change accepts most private insurance, and treatment packages are arranged by length of stay. Clients can choose from 30, 60, or 90 day programs, as well as a 14-day intensive residential package. Private aftercare sessions are provided for all clients to ensure ongoing support after treatment.

overviewH2: Foothills Centre for Change: Center Overview
overview: Foothills Centre for Change is a leading rehab center dedicated to offering individuals a holistic approach to wellness. The center focuses on providing compassionate care, encouragement, and comprehensive support to help patients get their lives back on track. At Foothills, patients can repair relationships, regain confidence, and rediscover their true selves through a range of programs and therapies tailored to meet their unique needs. With the right guidance and support, change is possible, and healing can begin today at Foothills.

The center provides a peaceful and comfortable environment where patients can receive world-class education, therapy, and wellness services. The team at Foothills understands that patients need a balance of self-care, therapy, and education to ensure a complete recovery. Therefore, patients are treated in a home-like setting designed to foster a calm and supportive atmosphere. Whether it’s addiction or mental health issues, Foothills Center for Change has the resources and expertise to help patients achieve positive outcomes and regain control of their lives.
serviceCaption: 11 services · as described on the centre's website
afterOverview: Foothills was started in 2014 by Parris Winsor, a clinical counsellor in recovery since 1995, and Darren Gulka, a registered psychiatric nurse whose own recovery began in 1991. They still run it, and they keep the guest group small on purpose. The centre says this helps people with social anxiety, trauma or shame open up sooner, and it means more one-to-one time with staff. Programs run on 12-step principles alongside CBT, DBT, motivational interviewing and the Gorski relapse prevention model. People have come from BC, Alberta, Saskatchewan, Ontario, the Yukon and the United States.

faqs.q: How much does Foothills Centre for Change cost?
faqs.a: recovery.com lists estimated cash-pay rates of $8,000 for the 2-week intensive, $14,800 for 30 days, $31,500 for 60 days and $46,500 for 90 days, in Canadian dollars. The centre's own website doesn't publish fees, so confirm the price with admissions before you book. The site links to Medicard if you want to finance the stay.

faqs.q: What programs does Foothills Centre offer?
faqs.a: Foothills Centre for Change offers 30, 60, or 90 day programs, as well as a 14-day intensive residential package.

faqs.q: Does Foothills Centre for Change offer detox?
faqs.a: No, not as a separate medical detox. The centre's website describes residential counselling programs and doesn't mention withdrawal management, and its recovery.com profile lists detox as not offered. If you are still drinking or using heavily, ask the intake team where to detox first, for example through Interior Health, before you arrive.

faqs.q: Where is Foothills Centre for Change and how do I get there?
faqs.a: The centre is at 4901 Lakeshore Rd NE in Salmon Arm, on the northeast side of town in BC's Shuswap region. From Vancouver it's roughly a 5 to 5.5 hour drive by the Coquihalla and Kamloops. Kamloops is about 1 hour 15 minutes away and Kelowna about 1 hour 30 minutes.
